You are reviewing an anonymous audiovisual EVENT DETECTOR X for a USER-REQUESTED COARSE PRELIMINARY estimate. The provided VIDEO INCLUDES ACTUAL ORIGINAL AUDIO, unchanged. First image identifies one physical target: 手中倾斜的小号金属锅本体, reference instant 36.0s. Full video length 64.12s. Track this physical instance, not all objects of its type. Green FRICTION and orange IMPACT banners appear only while X's respective prediction is ACTIVE; blank banner means no active prediction. Event numbers in the banner correspond to chronological input event entries. An event can be very short. Do not derive quality from code, complexity or a desired score. The marked reference instant is identity only.
Detect only actually audible impact or friction in which the marked physical target directly participates. An impact is a tap/knock/collision/clatter; friction is audible rubbing/scraping/sliding/brushing contact. Integrated handle/base belongs to target, loose tools, food, water, nested objects and a different object do not. Mere visible motion is not a sound. A stationary target can be struck; both contacting bodies count when directly involved. Pure pouring/splashing/food mixing/microphone rustle/voice is neither class. Track the SAME instance across time; reference instant is only identity, not an event annotation. Group same-class bursts separated by less than 0.40s; separate when gap >=0.40s. Start at audible onset and end at audible cessation including clear decay. Do not invent brief impacts from motion or all audio peaks. Unresolvable source attribution or masked texture must be marked uncertain, not silently called absent.
IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION LIMIT: this judge route distinguished silent,3-tone,5-tone inputs but failed a coarse onset timestamp control; precise time estimates and +/-80ms boundary grades are NOT qualified. Therefore DO NOT supply exact timestamps, measured TP/FP/FN or a strict F1/official total. Use source-position descriptions (beginning/middle/end and visible action) and visible banner event number to cite evidence; do not simulate listening. Evaluate marker-to-sound correspondence coarsely only. If sound or picture is unavailable, say so with null ratings.
For EACH class assess approximate precision P (fraction of triggers actually belonging to target in this class) and recall R (fraction of audible target class episodes covered by triggers) on discrete SCALE 0,1,2,3,4: 0 absent/almost all wrong,1 few correct/majority missing,2 roughly half,3 most correct with clear defects,4 all or almost all observably correct. These are coarse ordinal ESTIMATES, not event counts. For no class predictions P=null. If no audible target positive for a class, set has_target_positives=false and R=null; if audible positives exist but no trigger, R=0. Don't grant a zero-output target full recall merely because no banner appears.
For TWO difficult negative groups, other_object_sound and silent_target_action, state whether such opportunities are actually observed and rate suppression 0..4 only if observed. A motionless silent target is NOT silent_target_action. Negative quality 4 means no observed mis-triggers,0 most opportunities triggered incorrectly. Water-only sounds are not automatically either class. Coarse boundary 0..4 is only obvious continuity: cutoffs/very long tails/gaps, not exact80ms accuracy, and null when no supported target match.
Return COMPACT Chinese JSON only, no overall numeric total:

judgment.target_identity: 手中倾斜的小号金属锅本体

classes.audible_evidence: 在视频的大部分时间里，可以听到勺子刮擦和敲击小金属锅内壁的声音。这些声音表现为清脆的、带有金属质感的撞击声。
classes.visual_evidence: 从视频开始到结束（约0秒至64秒），操作者持续用勺子在目标小金属锅内进行舀取动作，勺子与锅体发生多次可见的物理接触。例如，事件1 (IMPACT) 发生在视频开头，当时勺子首次接触锅底；事件21 (IMPACT) 发生在视频末尾，此时锅内食物已大部分被舀出，勺子仍在刮擦锅壁以收集剩余物。

clear_candidate_errors.position_and_action: 整个视频中，每次勺子敲击或刮擦锅体时
clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 音频中混合了勺子刮擦锅壁的摩擦声和偶尔更尖锐的敲击声。由于两种声音紧密相连且音色相似，难以精确区分每一次是纯粹的“impact”还是“friction”。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 视觉上，勺子的运动轨迹既有贴着锅壁的滑动（倾向于产生friction），也有抬起后落下敲击的动作（倾向于产生impact）。

classes.audible_evidence: 可以听到持续的、较为柔和的金属刮擦声，这是勺子在内壁上滑动的结果。这种声音与更短促、响亮的撞击声有明显区别。
classes.visual_evidence: 当勺子紧贴着锅的内表面移动，试图将粘稠的绿色酱料刮下时，就发生了摩擦。例如，事件7 (FRICTION) 和事件19 (FRICTION) 都对应着勺子用力刮擦锅壁的动作。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 此处的声音听起来更像是一次清晰的敲击（impact），而非连续的刮擦（friction）。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 画面显示勺子似乎是点状地接触锅壁，而不是大面积地滑动。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 该时刻的声响特征更接近于一个孤立的撞击声。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 视觉上是勺子快速地从锅中提起并轻碰边缘的动作。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 声音短促而响亮，符合撞击的特征。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 动作是勺子向下按压并敲击锅底。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 听到的是一声明显的“铛”声，是典型的金属撞击音。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 勺子以一个角度切入并碰到了锅的边缘。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 这个声音虽然有些拖长，但起始部分是一个非常明确的撞击声。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 勺子先是敲了一下锅，然后才开始有轻微的刮动。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 与事件23类似，这是一个由强撞击开始的复合声音。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 同样是先敲击后刮动的组合动作。

clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 这是一次干净的敲击声，没有后续的刮擦尾音。
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 勺子垂直地敲击了一下锅底。

negative_groups.evidence: 视频中还有其他物体发出的声音，例如左侧炉灶上另一个锅里煎培根/香肠的滋滋声，以及搅拌棒放在碟子上的轻微碰撞声。检测器X没有将这些声音错误地标记为目标小金属锅的事件，表现出良好的抑制能力。
存在目标锅静止不动的时刻，例如在视频最开始（0秒）和操作者调整握姿的瞬间。在这些没有声音产生的时段，检测器也没有发出任何错误的触发信号。

judgment.coarse_boundary_evidence: 对于绝大多数正确分类的事件（尤其是impact类），其时间边界与可听见的声音起止基本吻合。然而，在一些被误判为friction的事件中（如事件7, 13, 15等），它们实际上是短暂的impact，这表明模型在处理瞬时事件的边界时可能存在混淆，将本应结束的impact事件延长或错误归类，导致边界不清晰。
limitations: 根据指令，此评估不进行精确的时间戳判断，因此对+/-80ms内的边界准确性不做评价。
impact和friction的声音在某些情况下高度重叠，使得即使是人工复核也难以做到100%准确的分类，这影响了precision和recall评分的绝对性。
